title: Jeremy's 5-Day Split Hard+Light
author: Jeremy S.
desc:
A 5-day split for size and strength with no barbell squatting. Hard days are chest and back, legs, then shoulders and arms, each built on two main lifts with full rest followed by supersetted accessories. The two light days are spaced 2 to 4 days from their matching hard day so every muscle gets hit twice a week without the light work piling onto fresh fatigue.

Legs run on a hack squat rather than a loaded barbell, capped at 8 to 12 reps to keep peak spinal load down. Direct low back work shows up twice a week, because the back is the limiter on how heavy the squat can go, not the legs.

Intensity is set with RPE. Hard day mains at 8, accessories at 9, everything on light days at 6. Light days stay light or they aren't doing their job.

Run the same week for 8 to 12 weeks and let the weights climb. Add 10 pounds total on upper body lifts when you hit the top of the rep range on all sets, 25 or more on the hack squat.
